title: "The Shadow of Destiny's Twins"
next_chapter_hook: "In the Void beyond the ruins, a call carrying the resonance of destiny pierced through the layers of formations, stabbing directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea— it was a voice from the depths of his bloodline, with an irresistible allure."

text.content: "The moment that gaze, surpassing the limits of perception, opened its eyes, Chen Ji felt as if he were being gazed upon by Heaven itself. That was not pressure, not killing intent, but something far more terrifying— observation. As if all his schemes, all his disguises, had become transparent jokes before that gaze. The Tianji Record Fragment vibrated frantically within his Mental Sea, each tremor like a warning, yet also a催促. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a sharp hiss: 'Go! Go now! Its true body is still sleeping, but that gaze has already locked onto you—'"

"Chen Ji did not move. He stood in place, letting that gaze sweep over his entire body. Strangely, he felt no fear. Instead, an uncanny calm enveloped him. He had come this far— what difference did fear make? What difference did courage make? The projection of the Heavenly Eye slowly dissipated, yet that final glance was deeply carved into his divine soul. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted to Chen Ji's side: 'That gaze just now... it was probing you. There is something on your body that it desperately wants.'"

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record itself? No, that's not right... The Tianji Record, though precious, should not warrant such urgency at its level. Unless... 'Unless there is something on you even more important than the Tianji Record.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji gave no answer. He turned and continued walking deeper into the ruins. Each step was steady, as if that gaze had been nothing more than a negligible gust of wind. But his mind raced. What did the Heavenly Eye want? Why was it so eager to descend? The corridor of the ruins grew wider, the air thick with ancient and rotting odors. Murals began appearing on the walls, their lines bold yet conveying an indescribable shock. Mo Xiansheng suddenly fell silent. Chen Ji stopped, looking at the murals. His pupils constricted sharply."

"The murals depicted two intertwined light silhouettes. One blazed with brilliance, as if carrying the fate of the entire world; the other was as dark as an abyss, as if bearing endless shackles. They entwined, they fought, yet could not be separated. Beneath the murals, an ancient inscription was carved, and Chen Ji recognized it— it was the script of the ancient Heavenly Secrets Sect. Mo Xiansheng's voice emerged hoarsely: 'These are... Destiny's Twins... Legend says that at the dawn of creation, Heavenly Will split itself in two... one half became the Prophet, the other half became...' He did not finish, but Chen Ji had already seen what was depicted at the murals' end."

"The light silhouette bearing the shackles was ultimately bound in chains, sinking into the endless abyss. And at the spot where it fell, a clear symbol appeared on the mural— identical to the incomplete mark on Chen Ji's Tianji Record Fragment. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried unprecedented gravity: 'So that's it... The Tianji Record is not some inheritance artifact, but... part of the shackles. You thought you were the Prophet? No, you are... the being Heaven uses to imprison the other half.' Chen Ji stared at that symbol, his heart churning with monstrous waves, yet his expression remained placid as still water."

dialogue.content: "'So the Demonic Path Commander... the existence called the other side of Destiny's Twins...' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, 'It does not want to destroy you, but to... reclaim the part of itself that was torn away.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji followed the murals deeper. He saw more— the complete process of Destiny's Twins from unity to division, from division to confrontation, ultimately one side imprisoning the other forever. One scene in the murals was particularly striking: before sinking into the abyss, the imprisoned light silhouette turned back for one glance. Its face was unclear, but those eyes were crystal clear— eyes identical to Chen Ji's own. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor: 'This is impossible... You are the prisoner, not...'"

"Chen Ji suddenly stopped walking. A sharp pain radiated from his chest, as if something was awakening. It was a familiar yet foreign sensation— like memories suppressed in the depths of his bloodline for years were breaking through their seals. In his Mental Sea, the incomplete mark on the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a faint glow, resonating across the distance with the symbol on the mural. Mo Xiansheng exclaimed: 'This is resonance! It's calling you! The imprisoned half is calling out to its other half!' Chen Ji pressed his hand against his chest, feeling that increasingly intense stirring."

choice.prompt: "At the murals' end stood an altar, and at its center floated an ancient bronze mirror. Reflected in the mirror was not Chen Ji's form, but another existence identical yet utterly different to him— the Demonic Path Commander. Those eyes stared directly at him, carrying indescribable emotion. And at the same time, in the Void beyond the ruins, a call carrying the resonance of destiny pierced through the layers of formations, stabbing directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea."

choices.text: "Face the figure in the mirror directly and accept the bloodline's call"
choices.description: "Since destiny has arranged things thus, he might as well proactively step into this fateful confrontation and see how these so-called twins intend to conclude this."
choices.visible_reward: "Unlock the passive 'Destiny Resonance,' allowing perception of the Demonic Path Commander's state and emotions"
choices.risk_hint: "May fall into the other's spiritual domain"

dialogue.content: "'Finally... you have come.' The figure in the mirror spoke, its voice identical to Chen Ji's yet carrying a weariness and沧桑 Chen Ji had never known, 'We were one body, torn apart for ten thousand years. You bear the shackles, I bear destiny... You think this is a curse, but you do not know this is Heaven's greatest lie.'"

choices.text: "Forcefully interrupt the resonance and maintain independence"
choices.description: "No matter the truth, he would never be anyone's chess piece, not even destiny itself."
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain independent consciousness; Tianji Record unlocks new skill 'Tianji Shield'"
choices.risk_hint: "May thoroughly provoke the other and trigger destiny's backlash"

text.content: "Chen Ji raised his hand abruptly, and a mysterious rune shot from his fingertips, slamming directly into the bronze mirror. The mirror's surface rippled violently, and the figure within let out a pained groan before slowly dissolving. But that voice still echoed in Chen Ji's mind: 'You will regret this... When we truly meet, you will understand what true loneliness is...' The mark on the Tianji Record Fragment flashed intensely, and Mo Xiansheng's voice was filled with worry: 'What did you do? You severed not just the resonance, but... the bonds of destiny!'"

choices.description: "How much does Mo Xiansheng know? As a guardian, what has he been hiding?"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain critical intelligence; Mo Xiansheng may reveal more secrets of the Tianji Record"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji did not look at the mirror but turned to face Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. His gaze was terrifyingly calm: 'You knew from the very beginning, didn't you? You knew who I am, what the Tianji Record is, the truth of all this. You used me as your chess piece, accomplishing what Chen Xuan could not... Now, shouldn't you tell me who your master truly is?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a long moment before finally letting out a sigh: 'You are far more terrifying than your father...'"

text.content: "The space around the altar began to distort. The two light silhouettes on the murals seemed to come alive, peeling slowly from the walls and hovering in the air. Destiny and Shackles, Prophet and Prisoner— they rotated slowly under Chen Ji's gaze, like two stars chasing each other. Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice rang out: 'Time is running out! When these two silhouettes completely separate, you will have to make a choice— become the master of destiny, or continue as the prisoner of the shackles!' Chen Ji stood still, watching those two lights approach him. There was no fear on his face, only an extraordinary calm."

"'Choice?' Chen Ji spoke softly, a mocking arc curling at the corner of his mouth, 'I never choose.' He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment flew out from his Mental Sea, hovering above his palm. The incomplete mark on the fragment suddenly burst forth with dazzling light, perfectly matching the symbol on the murals. The two light silhouettes, as if drawn by this power, rushed simultaneously toward Chen Ji. Mo Xiansheng shouted in terror: 'No! Have you gone mad! Two forces pouring into your body simultaneously, you will—' Before he could finish, the two lights had already entered Chen Ji's body."

"In that instant, Chen Ji felt as if he were being torn in two. One half was the existence bearing destiny, seeing through the trajectories of all things, foretelling every possibility of the future; the other half was the prisoner bearing shackles, enduring the weight of Heavenly Will, forever unable to escape. Agony swept over him like a tsunami, but Chen Ji gritted his teeth and forcibly suppressed the pain. His consciousness wavered between two extremes, yet always maintained a thread of clarity. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying unprecedented shock: 'You... you are fusing them? This is impossible! This is an act that defies Heaven!'"

choice.prompt: "The collision of the two forces plunged Chen Ji's consciousness into momentary chaos. Within that chaos, he saw a familiar figure— that was his other self, standing at the edge of the chaos, extending a hand toward him."

choices.text: "Grasp that hand and complete the fusion"
choices.description: "Since destiny demands he choose one or the other, he will break this rule— destiny and shackles were always meant to be one."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the complete form of 'Destiny Shackles'; Tianji Record upgrades to 'True Tianji Record,' unlocking complete foresight ability"
choices.risk_hint: "May fundamentally alter Chen Ji's form of existence"

text.content: "Chen Ji grasped that hand. The two forces collided thunderously within him, erupting with world-annihilating energy. The chaotic space began to collapse, yet within that collapse, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented wholeness. The mark on the Tianji Record Fragment was finally completed, transforming into a complete circle— half light, half shadow. In that instant, Chen Ji saw everything: the past, the present, the future, and... the true form of the Heavenly Eye."

choices.text: "Refuse that hand and maintain the self"
choices.description: "He does not need to become part of destiny; what he seeks is to transcend destiny itself."
choices.visible_reward: "Retain independent consciousness; obtain the title 'Destiny Defier'; the Destiny Twins can no longer directly perceive his thoughts"
choices.risk_hint: "May be viewed as a threat by the Destiny Twins"

text.content: "Chen Ji's hand halted in mid-air, not grasping that hand. The figure on the other side let out a low laugh: 'As expected... you are still that unyielding you. Very well, since you have chosen loneliness, let me see how far you can walk on this path...' Chaos collapsed, and Chen Ji's consciousness was violently hurled back to reality. He opened his eyes to find himself still standing before the altar, but everything around him had changed— the symbols on the murals had completely vanished, replaced by a glaring crack."

"That crack spread from the altar's center, like a trace of some ancient seal being broken. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul clung tightly to Chen Ji's side, his voice carrying a hint of unprecedented respect: 'Whatever choice you made... you have already altered the trajectory of destiny. From now on, neither you nor the Demonic Path Commander are chess pieces on Heaven's board anymore.' Chen Ji did not speak; he lowered his gaze to his own hands— two distinctly different lights swirled there, one bright and one dark, as if two souls within him had reached some subtle equilibrium."

dialogue.content: "Just then, a voice came from within that crack, clear as if whispered in his ear: 'You have changed... but it is not enough.' That voice carried a hint of a smile, yet also an unquestionable authority, 'When our gazes meet again, you will understand what true destiny is.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji raised his head and stared directly at that crack. His gaze was calm, yet a faint arc curled at the corner of his lips: 'I look forward to it.' The crack widened slowly, and a surge of power fluctuation far beyond this world gushed forth from within. Mo Xiansheng shouted urgently: 'It is coming! The true Demonic Path Commander— no, it should be said, the other half of the Destiny Twins! It is descending through this crack!' Chen Ji did not retreat; he stepped forward to meet that approaching power. Whether ahead lay destiny's ultimate showdown or an even deeper conspiracy, he was already prepared."

"In the Void beyond the ruins, a call carrying the resonance of destiny pierced through the layers of formations, stabbing directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea— it was a voice from the depths of his bloodline, with an irresistible allure. That voice was neither threat nor command, but a simple yet heavy plea: 'Come back... let me see you... my other half...' Chen Ji's body stiffened momentarily, then regained composure. He turned toward the ruins' exit, a meaningful arc curling at the corner of his lips. The gears of destiny had already begun to turn, and he would personally rewrite this ending."

dialogue.content: "'Did you hear that, Mo Xiansheng?' Chen Ji spoke softly, his voice carrying a hint of playfulness, 'It says I am its other half... but what it doesn't know is that I never intended to be anyone's shadow.' A cold light flickered in his eyes, 'Since it wants to see me, let it come. Ten thousand years ago it failed to kill me; this time... I will personally send it to meet the true Heaven.'"

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then let out a soft sigh: 'You have changed, Chen Ji. The old you would have chosen a more稳妥 approach...' Chen Ji gave no answer, merely gazing quietly at that widening crack. The old him would have calculated all risks before acting. But now, he no longer needed to hide. Since destiny's truth had been unveiled, let the storm come even more violently. The ruins began to shake violently, ancient stones falling from the ceiling. Chen Ji stood in the center of the collapse, allowing destiny's torrent to swallow him whole."

choice.prompt: "The crack had fully torn open, and the power of the Destiny Twins poured forth from within, shrouding the entire ruins in chaos. At this critical moment, Chen Ji must make his final choice."

choices.description: "Since the opponent has shown an opening, seize this opportunity to deliver a fatal blow and fundamentally change the battlefield."
choices.visible_reward: "Seize the initiative the moment the opponent descends; inflict massive damage and shock the entire arena"

text.content: "Chen Ji raised his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment transformed into a streak of light, shooting directly at that crack. The moment the light collided with the crack, the entire ruins seemed to ignite, emitting a deafening roar. From the depths of the crack came a muffled grunt, followed by a figure being violently shaken out. It was a face identical to Chen Ji's, yet radiating an entirely different temperament— overbearing, wild, and... furious at the offense. 'How dare you...' That voice carried murderous intent like a tidal wave, yet was also overtaken by an irrepressible shock."

choices.description: "The true confrontation is not now; withdrawing from the battlefield to gather more intelligence is the superior strategy."
choices.visible_reward: "Successfully withdraw and discover hidden information within the ruins, laying foundations for the final battle ahead"

text.content: "Chen Ji's form flickered and vanished from his position. The next instant, he had already appeared at the ruins' exit. Behind him, the existence within the crack let out a furious roar: 'Run? You think you can escape?' Chen Ji did not look back; the moment he stepped out of the ruins, he spoke softly: 'I am not running.' A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips, 'I am waiting for you to catch up.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a helpless sigh: 'You rascal... when did you become so skilled at provocation?'"

choices.text: "Face the opponent directly and engage in dialogue"
choices.description: "Before taking action, first clarify the opponent's true intentions and the truth behind this fateful confrontation."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain critical intelligence; the opponent may reveal the Heavenly Eye's true purpose"
choices.risk_hint: "May be affected by the opponent's spiritual attack"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji stopped, turning to face that crack. His voice was calm yet powerful: 'You wanted to see me, and I am here. Now, can you tell me— what exactly do you want?' Silence emanated from the crack, then that voice spoke again, this time carrying a hint of weariness: 'What I want... has always been only one answer.' A figure slowly walked out from the crack, and on that face identical to Chen Ji's complex emotions played out, 'Ten thousand years ago, we were one body. Ten thousand years later, we meet again... Tell me, is this destiny's arrangement or Heaven's joke?'"

text.content: "That figure stopped before Chen Ji, the two separated by mere three feet. This was them— the Destiny Twins— truly meeting for the first time after ten thousand years of separation. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul hovered nervously at Chen Ji's side, ready to strike at any moment. But Chen Ji raised his hand, signaling him not to act rashly. The Destiny Twins gazed at each other— one calm as water, the other fathomless. An strange atmosphere pervaded the air, like a long-awaited reunion, yet also the prelude to a fateful showdown. In the Void beyond the ruins, that call carrying the resonance of destiny echoed once more, this time with the bloodline's call growing even stronger and more urgent, as if urging on this destined encounter."
